title: Carrier Delivery Confirmation Rate and Bank Payouts, Pocketwire Business Profile
content:
The delivery confirmation keep-back percentage on a Pocketwire Business Profile is 4 percent when the carrier delivery confirmations dated within the rolling month ending on the handling date number fewer than 0.5 times the sales dated in that month, 1.5 percent when they number at least 0.5 but fewer than 0.8 times those sales, and nothing when they reach 0.8 times those sales. Both are counted by number of entries: carrier delivery confirmations recorded on the profile's sales, and sales. A rolling window of a number of months ending on the handling date covers the dates after the same calendar day that many months earlier, up to and including the handling date.

| Carrier delivery confirmations in the rolling month | Delivery confirmation keep-back percentage |
|---|---|
| fewer than half the number of sales | 4 percent |
| at least half, fewer than 0.8 times the number of sales | 1.5 percent |
| at least 0.8 times the number of sales | none |

## Worked counts (hypothetical month with 20 sales)

| Confirmations | Compared with | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| 9 | fewer than 10 | 4 percent |
| 10 | at least 10, fewer than 16 | 1.5 percent |
| 15 | fewer than 16 | 1.5 percent |
| 16 | at least 16 | none |
